name: Cube Against Cancer Tulsa 2026

venue.name: [Doubletree Tulsa at Warren Palace](Double Tree Tulsa at Warren Palace)

information: ## **This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer Tab.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerTulsa2026#70785-cube-against-cancer)** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerTulsa2026#70781-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. -Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerTulsa2026#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTY0MjIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--58334fe88aba2a4b3f014023d062797525b907ec/Southern_Cubing_Resize.jpg)
